stemMd: For which k does x² + kx + 9 = 0 have exactly one distinct real root?
explanationMd: A repeated real root requires discriminant k² − 36 = 0. Thus k² = 36 and k = ±6. The resulting polynomials are (x + 3)² and (x − 3)².

distractorRationale.d: The discriminant condition also allows negative six.
distractorRationale.c: This gives two distinct real roots.
distractorRationale.a: This gives x² + 9 = 0 with no real roots.
